description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Image_Canvas_PDF' responsible for generating PDF images with various graphic and text elements using PDFlib. It includes methods for drawing shapes, overlaying images, handling fonts, and outputting the final PDF document. The file also handles external dependencies on 'Image/Canvas.php' and 'Image/Canvas/Color.php'.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_PDF
classes.description: A class extending 'Image_Canvas' to facilitate the creation and output of PDF graphics using PDFlib. It manages PDF page setup, drawing primitives, text, and image overlays, and handles PDF document finalization and output.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_PDF
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the PDF canvas object based on provided parameters such as page size, orientation, and optional existing PDFlib resource.

methods.name: _getX
methods.description: Converts a relative x-coordinate (percentage of width) to an absolute page coordinate.

methods.name: _getY
methods.description: Converts a relative y-coordinate (percentage of height) to an absolute page coordinate, accounting for PDF coordinate system.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Converts a given color description to an RGB array scaled between 0 and 1 for PDFlib.

methods.name: _setLineStyle
methods.description: Configures the line style in PDFlib, including setting the line width and color.

methods.name: _setFillStyle
methods.description: Configures the fill style in PDFlib, including setting the fill color.

methods.name: _setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for subsequent text operations, loading the font via PDFlib and applying size and color.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the PDFlib graphics state to the defaults for new drawing operations.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with optional color, using PDFlib.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon shape, optionally filled and/or stroked.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle shape, optionally filled and/or stroked.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle, optionally filled and/or stroked.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Defines a pie slice shape; currently unimplemented in PDF, delegates to parent.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string in current font settings.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of text based on font size.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Writes text at specified coordinates with alignment and color options.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Embeds an image from a file onto the PDF at specified position, with optional size and alignment.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Finalizes and outputs the PDF document inline in the browser.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Finalizes and saves the PDF document to a specified filename.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Determines the installed major version of PDFlib.
